source: Wave 7 Step 1 (2026-06-02). WETH is the OP-Stack canonical predeploy at 0x4200...0006 (Unichain is OP-Stack-based, same WETH address as Base/Optimism/Mode/Zora). USDC native via Circle, address from Unichain documentation. USDC sorts BELOW WETH on Unichain (0x078D < 0x4200), making USDC=token0 — same flipped-order pattern as Optimism native USDC. Use priceMode='invert' and --stable-side 0 for any V3 probe.

WETH.note: Canonical OP-Stack WETH predeploy. Identical address on Base, Optimism, Unichain, Mode, Zora, Blast, etc.

USDC.note: Circle native USDC on Unichain. Address < 0x4200 (WETH), so token0=USDC on this chain — opposite of Base, same as Optimism native. Use priceMode='invert' and --stable-side 0.
